name: io.github.Yuuqq/jules-dispatch
description: Batch-dispatch coding tasks to Google Jules: 50 parallel sessions, plan approval, PR collection.

packageArguments.description: Run jules-dispatch as an MCP server over stdio

environmentVariables.name: JULES_DEFAULT_SOURCE
environmentVariables.description: Default Jules source, e.g. sources/github/owner/repo (optional if every task sets source)

environmentVariables.name: JULES_DEFAULT_BRANCH
environmentVariables.description: Default git branch for sessions (defaults to main)
